wiringInterpretation.rationale: Plan_final 08-008 wires the level-exit path via one src/vanilla facade (wireLevelExits.ts) re-exporting the read-only ai/bossSpecials (aBossDeath, BOSS_DEATH_TAG 666 = E1M8 episode-end gate) and ui/intermission (createIntermissionState, SP_STATE_INITIAL_PAUSE 1..SP_STATE_FINAL 10, WI timing incl. WI_SHOW_NEXT_LOC_TICS 140, TICRATE 35, WI_MAX_PERCENT 100, music/sound cue types). VANILLA_LEVEL_EXIT_INVARIANTS pins five rules (normal exit -> next map; secret exit -> secret map; E1M8 boss death ends the episode -> finale; 10-state SP intermission machine; 4-second next-location pointer). The focused test exercises the exit/intermission constants, the callable aBossDeath + createIntermissionState entry points, the frozen manifest, the ../-filtered specifier set, and dynamic same-reference identity, keeping the test inventory-neutral. No const enums. This step became eligible only after the 442975e cycle fix removed the spurious 10-006 back-edge (08-008 <-> 10-006).
